about_the_game:
You’ve left something behind… but your heart still guides you.

In Moonlight Paw, you play as Aylune Lunaria—a clumsy, shy, but warmhearted young vet who moves to Heiyukai, a strange island where humans, spirits, and magical creatures live together (sometimes peacefully... sometimes not).

You’ll open a small clinic, care for adorable spirit pets, and try to uncover why this place feels so special. The island has rules, people have secrets—and maybe someone familiar is waiting for you there.

🐾 Mornings are for drinking some tea or coffee, then feeding, cleaning, and giving checkups to cute magical pets.
🐾 Afternoons get wild—you’ll dive into light, funny bullet-hell battles to cure serious illnesses.
🐾 Evenings are your time to relax, cook food at your stall, explore the town, or hang out with new friends.

You’ll also work side-by-side with your clinic assistants—each with their own personality, skills, and stories to tell.

Whether you’re brushing a youkai, roasting festival snacks, or slowly exploring your own story… there’s always something happening under the moonlight.

✨ Features:

  • 🎀 Story-Rich Pixel RPG – A lighthearted and comedy story + character-driven quests, with light emotional and hidden drama

  • 🐶 Magical Vet Gameplay – Treat unusual pets using lighthearted tools, minigames, and cute magical items.

  • 💫 Bullet-Hell Healing Battles – Customize your style and heal pets with colorful patterns and silly attacks.

  • 🧹 Clinic Life-Sim – Feed, clean, restock, and assign tasks to your cheerful (and chaotic) assistant girls.

  • 🍜 Evening Activities – Run your food stall, go fishing, take on side quests, or chill at town festivals.

  • 🏮 Urban Fantasy World – Inspired by Japanese, Korean, and Chinese folklore, plus modern technology into urban fantasy.

  • 💕 Lovable Characters – Deep backstory, charming designs, memorable dialogue, and meme-worthy.

  • 🎮 No Meta, Just Fun – Customize your bullets, skills, and passives however you like. Play your way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-2100 or AMD Athlon II
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD HD 7790
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Moonlight Paw is a story-rich, pixel-art, and life-sim JRPG game where you run a magical vet clinic on a mysterious island filled with people, spirits, and mythic beings. Open your clinic, heal magical pets with bullet-hell cuteness, run a food stall, and make memories with people across the island.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Thai
